services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Are you looking for a unique and unforgettable experience in Boston Harbor? Look no further than Liberty Clipper's private charters! Our traditionally rigged schooner, with its tall masts and white sails, offers the perfect setting for a personalized and exciting adventure on the water. Imagine yourself on the deck of the Liberty Clipper, surrounded by breathtaking views of the harbor and the city skyline. As you relax and take in the scenery, you can feel the cool breeze on your face and hear the sound of the waves gently lapping against the boat. checkin: We're looking forward to your reservation! Please arrive a minimum of 15 minutes early, for an easy check-in.
cancellation: WEATHER CANCELLATION POLICY: In the event your trip on the Liberty Clipper is cancelled by the captain due to inclement weather, Liberty Clipper does NOT offer refunds, you will have the chance to rebook on any available sails, or you will receive company credit in the amount of your ticket(s) price. Please note: The Liberty Clipper will sail in the rain.
policies: What to bring Dress for the weather!
Items cancelled outside 72 hours are entitled to a full refund minus a 20% admin fee.
If the weather is inclement and the ship does not sail we will do our best to reschedule you.
Additional information Rain Date: Due to the unpredictable nature of fall weather, a rain date of October 10th has been set for this event.
Items cancelled outside 1 week are entitled to a full refund minus a 20% admin fee.

The reservations are NON-CANCELABLE AND NON-REFUNDABLE WITHIN 90 DAYS OF THE SAILING DATE.
